Two rows of LC duplex adapters carrying channels 921-960 plus Line, 1510 OSC filter and cross-connects XC1-XC4, with ETH0 and RS232 management.","format":1,"groups":{"channels":{"attrs":{"media":"fiber","role":"channel"},"description":"the 40 add/drop channel ports, silkscreened 921-960. They alternate in pairs between the two rows - 921/922 upper, 923/924 lower - so the rows are a layout, not a block","index-origin":1,"term":"Port"},"mgmt":{"index-origin":1,"mixed":"the rear management block - ETH1-4 on RJ45 to the shelf controller, ETH5 as an SFP for optical management access, and the recessed reset beside them. DCP-R User Manual 14.0 A section 2.10 lists them as one set of network management interfaces","term":"Port"},"xc":{"attrs":{"media":"fiber","role":"cross-connect"},"description":"XC1-XC4, the cross-connect ports. DCP-R User Manual 14.0 A section 2.1.2 has degrees interconnected either through the LC cross-connects or through the five connections carried in the MPO. Two sit in the upper row and two in the lower, which is why a positional grouping split them","index-origin":1,"term":"Port"}},"kind":"device","manufacturer":"Smartoptics","model":"DCP-R-9D-CS","name":"dcp-r-9d-cs","profile":"optical","provenance":{"channel-plan":"silkscreen - channels alternate in pairs between rows, 921/922 top then 923/924 bottom, continuing to 960","chassis":"manual DIMENSIONS (DCP-R) - 440mm (W) x 45mm (H) x 505mm (D), 1 RU","column-grid":"top and bottom rows agreed across all 23 columns, so one averaged grid is used and the drawing jitter discarded","markings":"photo - IEC 60825 laser hazard triangles in the gap between the two port blocks, matching the 34D","port-pairing":"each LC duplex adapter carries two connection points about 6.6mm apart, one per fiber; adapters recovered by pairing those","port-positions":"stencil ShapeSheet connection points, which Visio stores as fractions of shape width/height and therefore survive without the drawing scale. Resolved against the 19-inch rack width the master is drawn at.","psu-orientation":"photo - both modules are fitted the same way round, fan inboard of the inlet, so the C14 sits at the far right on PSU-2 and inboard on PSU-1. They are not mirrored","psu-part":"label - Gospower G1251-0550WNA, P/N CRPS0550-AH, and the fan sticker reads 550W Platinum CRPS. So the module is a standard CRPS 1U part at 73.5 x 40 x 185, not the 84mm-wide estimate taken from the racked photo, and both bays sit flush to the chassis edges","rear-layout":"photo IMG_2181 of racked DCP-R units - PSU with integrated fan and C14 inlet at each end, mirrored; honeycomb vent panel across the centre; management block right of centre. Block positions are approximate to about 3mm - the photo has uncorrected perspective and partial cable occlusion, so it fixes the structure and order but not exact millimetres","rear-mgmt-block":"stencil master dcp-r-rear, which is orthographic - a 2x2 ganged RJ45 shell (ETH 2 / ETH 4 over ETH 1 / ETH 3), ESD warning, Tx and Rx LEDs, an ETH 5 SFP cage and a recessed RESET button","side-top-bottom":"IMG_2188 shows the lid, so these now carry the real finish - a light silver body with the black front panel wrapping about 12.7mm (half an inch) back along every face. Still no vents, screws or lid labels - the photo shows the finish and the panel depth but not those details, so they are left out rather than invented","tx-rx-boxes":"photo - every optical port carries a boxed Tx/Rx pair between its name and the adapter, split by a divider, reversed on the bottom row","y-scale":"this master is drawn 46.0mm tall against a 45mm chassis, so y was scaled by 45/46.0.
